mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% consistently signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate investments.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that depress corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced consumer spending and investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1300 thousand units signals weak residential demand that reduces construction sector activity and consumer confidence, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1300, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and employment growth indicates a tightening labor market that boosts corporate hiring costs and profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved earnings visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE and PAYEMS both decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% for two consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates for equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during tightening cycles, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS above 650,000 million dollars) consistently supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated profit expectations and reduced recession risk.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 650,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in consumer spending indicates supply-demand mismatch that disrupts economic stability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through inflationary pressures and reduced corporate output.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines and RSAFS rises, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In supply-constrained regimes (INDPRO growth below 0.5% for two consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate production capacity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during supply constraints, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
